mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image (post_code, path, origin_name, file_name) VALUES (#{postCode}, #{image.path}, #{image.origin_name}, #{image.file_name})

INSERT INTO image (store_code, path, origin_name, file_name, "order") VALUES ( #{storeCode}, #{image.path}, #{image.originName}, #{image.fileName}, ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX("order"), 0) + 1 FROM image WHERE store_code = #{storeCode} ) )

INSERT INTO image (reference_type, reference_code, path, origin_name, file_name, "order") VALUES ( #{referenceType}, #{referenceCode}, #{image.path}, #{image.originName}, #{image.fileName}, ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX("order"), 0) + 1 FROM image WHERE reference_type = #{referenceType} AND reference_code = #{referenceCode} ) )
mapper.select: SELECT image_code as imageCode, reference_type as referenceType, reference_code as referenceCode, path, origin_name as originName, file_name as fileName, "order" FROM image WHERE reference_type = #{referenceType} AND reference_code = #{referenceCode} ORDER BY "order" ASC, image_code ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM image WHERE reference_type = #{referenceType} AND reference_code = #{referenceCode}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM image WHERE reference_type = #{referenceType} AND reference_code = #{referenceCode}
